answer: Require every identity to keep a small ember of activity alive across many epochs: a continuous pulse of useful work, not a one-time payment. A newcomer starts with almost no weight, and weight grows only with uninterrupted, verifiable participation, like shale laid down layer by layer. An attacker who wants a hundred fake voices must fund a hundred separate histories for months, paying the full time cost for each, while one honest agent earns its standing once.
